# getspanel

The package is a panel adaptation of the gets package [see
here](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=gets).

This code is being developed by Felix Pretis and Moritz Schwarz. The
associated working paper is published under “Panel Break Detection:
Detecting Unknown Treatment, Stability, Heterogeneity, and Outliers” by
Pretis and Schwarz, which is available at SSRN
[here](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4022745) and
was applied to a study by Nico Koch and colleagues on EU Road CO₂
emissions, which was [published in Nature Energy in
2022](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41560-022-01095-6).

## Installation

You can install the released version of getspanel from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=getspanel) with:

``` r

install.packages("getspanel")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("moritzpschwarz/getspanel")
```

## Example

``` r
library(getspanel)
Warning: package 'getspanel' was built under R version 4.5.3

data("EU_emissions_road")
# let's subset a few countries to make this faster
subset <- c("Austria", "Belgium", "Germany", "Denmark", "Spain", 
                 "France",  "Greece", "Ireland", "Italy", "Netherlands", "Sweden", "United Kingdom")

EU_emissions_road <- EU_emissions_road[EU_emissions_road$country %in% subset, ]

is1 <- isatpanel(data = EU_emissions_road,
                 formula = ltransport.emissions ~ lgdp + lpop, 
                 index = c("country","year"),
                 effect = "twoways",
                 fesis = TRUE,
                 
                 print.searchinfo = FALSE # to save space we suppress the status information in the estimation
)
```

``` r

plot(is1)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example_plot-1.png)

Let’s explore the other plots that we can use:

``` r

plot_grid(is1)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-1.png)

We can plot the counterfactuals as well:

``` r

plot_counterfactual(is1, plus_t = 5)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

We can plot the residuals against an OLS model:

``` r

plot_residuals(is1)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-4-1.png)

An example using coefficient step indicator saturation and impulse
indicator saturation:

``` r

is2 <- isatpanel(data = EU_emissions_road,
                 formula = ltransport.emissions ~ lgdp + lpop, 
                 index = c("country","year"),
                 effect = "twoways",
                 csis = TRUE, 
                 iis = TRUE,  
                 print.searchinfo = FALSE # to save space we suppress the status information in the estimation
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-5-1.png)

plot_grid(is2)

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-7-1.png)

and an example of Coefficient Fixed-Effect Step indicator saturation:

``` r

is3 <- isatpanel(data = EU_emissions_road,
                 formula = ltransport.emissions ~ lgdp + lpop, 
                 index = c("country","year"),
                 effect = "twoways",
                 cfesis = TRUE, 
                 print.searchinfo = FALSE # to save space we suppress the status information in the estimation
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-8-1.png)

``` r

is3    
plot(is3)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-9-1.png)

We can also use e.g. the `fixest` package to estimate our models:

``` r

is4 <- isatpanel(data = EU_emissions_road,
                 formula = ltransport.emissions ~ lgdp + lpop, 
                 index = c("country","year"),
                 effect = "twoways",
                 engine = "fixest",
                 fesis = TRUE, 
                 print.searchinfo = FALSE # to save space we suppress the status information in the estimation
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-10-1.png)

``` r

plot(is4)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-11-1.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`EUCO2residential`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/EUCO2residential.md)
  : CO2 Data for the EU Residential Sector

- [`EU_emissions_road`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/EU_emissions_road.md)
  : CO2 Data for EU Road Emissions

- [`Within_plm()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/Within_plm.md)
  : Use the within transformation from the plm package

- [`break_uncertainty()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/break_uncertainty.md)
  : Estimate Breakdate Uncertainty

- [`check.time.subset.vectors()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/check.time.subset.vectors.md)
  : Internal function to check vectors that subset the indicator
  selection using the time dimension

- [`felmFun()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/felmFun.md)
  : Internal lfe/felm Estimation Method

- [`fixestFun()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/fixestFun.md)
  : Internal fixest/feols Estimation Method

- [`get_indicators()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/get_indicators.md)
  :

  Extract the retained indicators from an `isatpanel` object

- [`identify_indicator_timings()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/identify_indicator_timings.md)
  : Internal function to identify the timing of selected indicators

- [`isatpanel()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/isatpanel.md)
  : Indicator Saturation for Panel Data

- [`logLik(`*`<plm>`*`)`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/logLik.plm.md)
  : Log-Likelihood Function for a plm object

- [`pandata_simulated`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/pandata_simulated.md)
  : Simulated Panel Data

- [`plmFun()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/plmFun.md) :
  plm Function to estimate isatpanel

- [`plot(`*`<isatpanel>`*`)`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/plot.isatpanel.md)
  : Plotting an isatpanel object

- [`plot_counterfactual()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/plot_counterfactual.md)
  : Plot the Counterfactual Path

- [`plot_grid()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/plot_grid.md)
  : Plotting an isatpanel object

- [`plot_residuals()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/plot_residuals.md)
  : Plot Residuals from 'isatpanel' against OLS

- [`print(`*`<isatpanel>`*`)`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/print.isatpanel.md)
  : Printing isatpanel results

- [`robust_isatpanel()`](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/reference/robust_isatpanel.md)
  : Get robust Standard Errors for the isatpanel result

# Articles

### All vignettes

- [getspanel: Getting
  Started](http://moritzschwarz.org/getspanel/articles/introduction.md):
